**Gatherlist** – material checklists for your builds.

**Install:** put `gatherlist-26.2.jar` into your `mods` folder. You need [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for Minecraft 26.2.

Press the key right of `0` (US: `-`) in game to open it. You can change the key under *Options → Controls → Gatherlist*.

Client-side only – works on any server, no server install needed.
